clue.text: Wild horse's need — a new grazing, primarily

parts.note: to need something is a must

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so only the opening letter of grazing is taken

explanation.surface: A wild horse's chief requirement is fresh pasture to graze on.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after horse is short for 'is', linking the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The feral horse of the American plains is called by this Spanish-derived name.

clue.text: Flies around Georgia providing substance for riot control

indicators.note: around tells us one word wraps itself about the other one

parts.note: to fly along is to tear, so flies gives tears
GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

explanation.surface: Insects buzzing round the state of Georgia offer something for police to use on rioters.
explanation.walkthrough: Flies looks like a noun (insects) but is the verb: rushes, tears.
explanation.definitionFit: Police disperse rioting crowds with this irritant chemical vapour that makes eyes stream.

clue.text: Surrey town kid, perhaps, to go before principal

indicators.note: to go before places the first piece ahead of the second in the answer

parts.note: kid is a soft goatskin, one example of a tanned hide material
the principal of a school is its head

explanation.surface: A young person from a Surrey town hopes to be seen by the headteacher.
explanation.walkthrough: Surrey is a county just south-west of London. Kid looks like a child but is the goatskin.
explanation.definitionFit: This market town lies in Surrey, the county south-west of London, near Epsom.

clue.text: Disorderly crowd, some abominably backward!

indicators.note: backward means the letters found are read in reverse order
some means only a part of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: An unruly throng behaves in a truly abominable way.
explanation.walkthrough: BOM sits inside aBOMinably and is turned round by 'backward'.
explanation.definitionFit: A rowdy, unruly throng of people is a common synonym for this short word.

clue.text: Take excessive time to be one of the gang?

definitions.meaning: read as two words, to dawdle is to be slow or tardy

definitions.text: to be one of the gang?
definitions.meaning: to fit in as a member of a group

explanation.walkthrough: The first sense splits the answer as BE LONG; the second reads it as one word.
explanation.definitionFit: Split in two it means to dawdle; as one word it means to be a member of a group.

clue.text: Small insect that is circling old, suave fellow

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

indicators.note: circling means the insect wraps round the next piece

parts.note: a moth is a winged insect
IE (id est) is the Latin abbreviation for that is

explanation.surface: A slick charmer is pictured as a tiny bug.
explanation.definitionFit: A suave, ingratiating man with polished manners is called this colloquially.

clue.text: Heath's vote in Europe initially miscast: those opposed win

indicators.note: cast wrongly, so the letters are thrown into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: the name with its s counted as a letter here
taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: initially indicates taking just the opening letter of Europe

explanation.surface: Edward Heath, UK prime minister, cast his vote on Europe badly, and his opponents carried the day.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward Heath took Britain into the European Community; 'miscast' rearranges HEATHS, VOTE, IN and E. Here the 's gives a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Commons Speaker's formula announcing that a division has gone against the motion.

clue.text: Compromise Mrs Hudson provided for Holmes?

definitions.meaning: a settlement reached by give and take
Mrs Hudson was Sherlock Holmes's landlady at 221B Baker Street, giving him lodgings

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful second sense: lodgings, or rooms to live in.
explanation.definitionFit: It means both an agreement reached by mutual concession and lodgings offered to a tenant.

clue.text: Dandy's invitation to bird to pay a brief visit?

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, linking definition and wordplay

parts.note: to pop in is to make a short call
a jay is a bird of the crow family

explanation.surface: A fop asks a bird to drop by for a moment.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as a call to a bird: 'Pop in, jay!' The words 'invitation to' set that up.
explanation.definitionFit: A vain, showily dressed man is called this old word, once meaning a parrot.

clue.text: Disloyal leader abandons search with regret

indicators.note: the leader is the first letter, and it leaves the word for search

parts.note: to search is to hunt
to rue something is to regret it

explanation.surface: A treacherous chief walks out on a manhunt, full of remorse.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone faithless or false to a partner or cause is described by this word.

clue.text: Leading lady taking a long time

indicators.note: taking means the first piece takes on the next one beside it

parts.note: ER (Elizabeth Regina) is the Queen, the nation's leading lady

explanation.surface: A star actress is having a lengthy spell in the limelight.
explanation.walkthrough: Leading lady suggests a star actress; it is the Queen, ER.
explanation.definitionFit: An age or epoch, a lengthy period of history, is this word.

clue.text: Swimmer's antics finally make defending player laugh?

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, linking definition and wordplay

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of antics

parts.note: to tickle a full-back, a defender in football, would make that player laugh

explanation.surface: Some playful antics are meant to amuse a defender on the pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: A back is a defender in football or hockey; tickling the back makes the player laugh.
explanation.definitionFit: This small spiny fish of ponds and streams is a swimmer.

clue.text: Large woman stocking oil preparation and fat

indicators.note: stocking means keeping something inside, so the name holds the next piece

parts.note: Ann is a woman's name

indicators.note: a preparation is something made up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A big lady stocks up on an oily lotion and grease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'preparation' is the anagram signal working on oil alone, and 'stocking' is the container signal; 'and' merely links wordplay to the definition at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: This greasy substance from sheep's wool is a fat used in ointments and cosmetics.

clue.text: Crazy person's argument against teachers

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, linking definition and wordplay

indicators.note: against sets one piece side by side with the other

parts.note: NUT is the National Union of Teachers, a British trade union
a case is an argument put forward

explanation.surface: A madman builds a case against the teaching profession.
explanation.definitionFit: A slang term for a lunatic or eccentric is this compound word.

clue.text: Greek character holding legal defence: not the last resort

indicators.note: holding means the Greek letter grips the other piece inside it

parts.note: mu is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: not the last says the final letter is dropped

parts.note: an alibi is a defence that one was elsewhere

explanation.surface: A Greek figure with a legal defence knows it is not his final recourse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not the last resort' looks like a phrase; resort is the definition alone.
explanation.definitionFit: This beach city on the coast near Los Angeles is a well-known seaside resort.

clue.text: Lodge housing boy — Holmes's study was in it

indicators.note: housing means providing room inside for another piece

parts.note: a set (or sett) is a badger's burrow, its lodge
Carl is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A lodge provides rooms for a lad, and Sherlock Holmes studied there.
explanation.walkthrough: A Study in Scarlet was the first Sherlock Holmes story; study is a pun on the title.
explanation.definitionFit: The first Holmes novel was A Study in this colour, so the study was 'in' it.

clue.text: With energy in Mantua he developed a seat of learning

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation inside the rearranged letters
developed means worked into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An energetic man in the Italian city of Mantua founded a centre of study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developed' signals the anagram and 'in' places the energy symbol inside its result; Mantua is an Italian city, a fitting setting for a seat of learning.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after Athena's temple, this word denotes a literary or scientific institution or library.

clue.text: Revered mentor in good old city university

parts.note: Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A respected tutor works at a good university in an ancient city.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu spiritual teacher, and by extension any trusted adviser, is so called.

clue.text: Heat regulator that's used to greatest degree in the desert?

definitions.text: Heat regulator that's used to greatest degree in the desert?

parts.words: Heat regulator that's used to greatest degree in the desert?
parts.note: a temperature control device, imagined as working hardest where it is hottest, under a desert sun

explanation.walkthrough: The heat regulator is real; the joke is that in the desert it would be working at its limit.
explanation.definitionFit: A device that keeps temperature steady by switching heating on and off.

clue.text: Sound girl welcomed into a posh circle

indicators.note: welcomed into means the name goes inside the surrounding letters

parts.note: U means upper-class, as in U and non-U
O has the shape of a circle
Di is a girl's name, short for Diana

explanation.surface: A girl is admitted into an exclusive social set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective (healthy) but is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Recorded or transmitted sound, as opposed to vision, is this word.

clue.text: Sucker upset over wearing woman's footwear

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the word is turned upside down

parts.note: a mug is a gullible person, a sucker

indicators.note: wearing means the woman has the next piece on, around it

parts.note: she is a pronoun for a woman
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: A gullible chap, distressed, has a lady's shoe on.
explanation.definitionFit: A gumshoe is a rubber overshoe or sneaker, and slang for a private detective.

clue.text: They may be studied members of the citizenry

definitions.meaning: topics or disciplines taken at school
people under the rule of a monarch or state

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both areas of study and people owing allegiance to a sovereign.

clue.text: Speech supporting senior officer's arrangement of shades

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting puts the speech underneath the officer

parts.note: Col is the abbreviation for Colonel
an oration is a formal speech

explanation.surface: A colonel's address is backed up by a colour scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: Colouring, the arrangement of hues in a thing, is called this (American spelling).

clue.text: Soldiers won't be in it if improperly dressed

definitions.text: Soldiers won't be in it if improperly dressed

parts.words: Soldiers won't be in it if improperly dressed
parts.note: dressing ranks means lining troops up straight; a badly dressed line is not straight

explanation.walkthrough: Dressed suggests uniform; in drill, to dress is to line up.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrangement in a straight line, as troops dressing their ranks.

clue.text: Contrived phrase on a large marine mammal

indicators.note: contrived means artificially arranged, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: An artificial turn of phrase concerns a big sea creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contrived' rearranges PHRASE into HARPSE.
explanation.definitionFit: This Arctic seal, with a harp-shaped mark on its back, is a marine mammal.

clue.text: Murderer liable to be imprisoned: Ahab was one

indicators.note: to be imprisoned puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: Cain killed his brother Abel in Genesis
apt means liable or inclined

explanation.surface: A killer likely to be jailed: Ahab was one.
explanation.walkthrough: Ahab, in Moby-Dick, commanded the whaler Pequod.
explanation.definitionFit: Ahab was master of the Pequod in Melville's novel, its commanding officer.

clue.text: Blissful state Granny discovered digesting current Bible

indicators.note: digesting means swallowing, so the granny takes the next pieces inside

parts.note: nana is a familiar word for grandmother
I is the physics symbol for electric current
RV is the Revised Version of the Bible

explanation.surface: Grandma was found absorbing an ongoing Bible study.
explanation.definitionFit: In Buddhism, this is the state of perfect peace and release, so bliss.

clue.text: What barrackers do — terrible cheek when Liberal is involved

indicators.note: is involved means the abbreviation is put inside the other letters
terrible means badly formed, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Hecklers are shockingly rude when a Liberal is taking part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' rearranges CHEEK into HECKE, and 'is involved' puts L inside. To barrack is British for jeering at a speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: To barrack is to interrupt a speaker with jeers, the same as this verb.

clue.text: Like a hooter city hospital overhauled

indicators.note: overhauled in a down clue means the whole thing is hauled over, upside down

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
a san is a sanatorium, a hospital

explanation.surface: A city hospital has been overhauled, like a hooter.
explanation.walkthrough: Hooter is slang for a nose; LASAN read upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Hooter is slang for nose, and this adjective means relating to the nose.

clue.text: Organ stop, originally — type briefly used

indicators.note: originally takes the first letter of stop
briefly means cut short, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a kind is a type

explanation.surface: An organ stop is a standard sort used in the instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: Organ stop suggests the musical instrument; organ is the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: The body's largest organ is the outer covering of a person.
